[[Mahrek Churi]] is an [[non-player character|NPC]] found in [[Resplendent Makuun]] just outside the portal to [[Bokka Amphitheatre]].

==Location==
*[[Vabbi]]
**{{NPC location|Resplendent Makuun}}

==Dialogue==
:''"I clean the [[Bokka Amphitheatre|theatre]]. It's not much, but it keeps me in the business until I get my break. One thing's for sure...cleaning up after all of you has made me a wealthy man, and well-informed. You'd be amazed what people write on their programs."''

==Quotes==
:''"I would have delivered that line with more feeling, more...volume."''

==Trivia==
*This character's name is supposedly a tribute to Mark Currie, the Alpha Tester of [[Guild Wars]] campaigns, as well as Prima Official [[Factions]] Strategy Guide and [[Nightfall]] Guidebook.
